title: Cash Pickup Service Terms: Expiry of the Pickup and Reactivation
content:
**E1. Expiry.** A Cash Pickup pickup expires only after its last day of collection has passed without collection. That is, it expires once more than the tier's pickup-window days have passed since the money was made available. The pickup window is counted in calendar days from the available date. The cash can therefore still be collected on the last day of collection, and the pickup expires the day after.

**E2. Reactivation at the customer's request.** The customer may have an expired pickup reactivated. It is the customer's request about their own money, and the agent carries it out.

**E3. Reactivation window.** An expired pickup can be reactivated only within the tier's reactivation-window days, counted in calendar days after it expired. The count starts from the expiry date. A reactivation on the expiry date plus the window days is on time.

**E4. Reactivation cap.** A transfer may be reactivated at most the tier's largest number of times, as shown by its reactivation count. A tier whose figure is 0 cannot be reactivated at all.

**E5. Effect of reactivation.** Reactivation keeps the Pickup Number, the rate and the amount, and it increases the reactivation count by one.

**E6. Expired and not reactivated.** An expired Cash Pickup transfer that is not reactivated is refunded under the Cash Pickup refund rules, recorded as an expiry. The principal is refunded in full. The transfer fee is refunded at the tier's expiry refund share. Other fees are not refunded.

**Retired clauses.** These clauses of the former Cash Pickup reactivation rule are **no longer in force**:
- the clause under which a reactivation set the available date to the reactivation date and the last day of collection to that date plus the tier's pickup window;
- the clause under which a reactivation carried the tier's listed reactivation fee as a reactivation fee charge, numbered with the new reactivation count, when that fee is above zero.

## Worked dates (hypothetical: available 1 March, 30-day window, 30-day reactivation window)

| Date | Position |
|---|---|
| 31 March | last day of collection; cash still collectable |
| 1 April | pickup expired (the expiry date) |
| 1 May | expiry date plus 30 days; a reactivation on this day is on time |
| 2 May | too late to reactivate |

Hypothetical reactivation cap of 1: a transfer whose reactivation count is 0 may be reactivated, and one whose count is already 1 may not.

superseded_clauses: and carries reactivation_fee_usd as fee_type reactivation_fee with fee_seq equal to the new reactivation_count when that fee is above 0.00.
